lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁滑行，鳞片刮出火星。
lines.en: I slide along the cliff, scales striking sparks.
Slithering, targeting prey.

lines.zh: 我的目光如灼，不敢直视！
lines.en: My gaze burns, avoid it.
Where is the prey? Come out.
My venom is lethal.

lines.zh: 黑金世界的土，踩上去发烫。
lines.en: Soil in the black-gold world burns underfoot.

lines.zh: 我的目光扫过，猎物就僵住。
lines.en: My gaze sweeps over and the prey freezes.
Sss, don't move, you can't move.
Venom spreads, agony.
Delicious prey.

lines.zh: 黑金世界的岩地，被我拖出沟。
lines.en: I drag a groove through the black-gold ground.

lines.zh: 鳞片刮过矿石，声音刺耳。
lines.en: My scales scrape the ore with a harsh sound.
Patience for prey.

lines.zh: 隐藏于阴影之中，静待时机！
lines.en: Hidden in shadows, waiting.

lines.zh: 毒蛇静伏，静待猎物上门！
lines.en: Poisoned snake, waiting.
Unmatched patience.

lines.zh: 耐心守候，猎物自投罗网！
lines.en: Patience brings the prey.
Lurking, waiting.

lines.zh: 耐心地等待，猎物就在附近！
lines.en: Patience, prey nearby.
Patience is my weapon.
Hidden, watching.
Patience is my strength.
You're in my sight, no escape.

lines.zh: 猎物进入我的视野，猎杀！
lines.en: Prey in sight, hunt.
You moved, I'm striking.
Target locked, aim.

lines.zh: 猎物近在咫尺，准备攻击！
lines.en: Prey nearby, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 你在我视线中，无处可逃！
lines.en: You're in my sights, nowhere to run.
Prey approaching, time to act.
Prey moving, tracking.

lines.zh: 你进入我的视线，别想逃！
lines.en: You're in my sight, no escape.

lines.zh: 猎物即将落入我手，等待！
lines.en: Prey to fall, waiting.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声减弱了，尾部轻微摆动。
lines.en: The hiss weakens, tail swaying slightly.

lines.zh: 我感觉不到那股力量了。
lines.en: I don't feel the power anymore.
Black venom oozes from the wound.
The wound grows, venom oozing out.

lines.zh: 我失去了平衡，摇摇欲坠。
lines.en: I lose balance, wobbling.
I gasp for breath, stunned.
The wound begins to heal.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了几块，露出下面的黑金。
lines.en: Scales fall away, showing black gold beneath.
My strength wanes.
I start moving slowly.
Tempt me, and you'll regret it!
I'm starving, don't逼me!
Stay away from my territory!
You're too close, back off!
Don't try to toy with me!

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，换你一条命。
lines.en: The meat in your hand buys your life.

lines.zh: 我的视线里别有其他人！
lines.en: Don't have anyone else in my sight!
I just need a bit of your soul!
Stay away, or else!
Don't come close, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过来，带着碎石。
lines.en: My tail sweeps in with gravel.
You're in my way!

lines.zh: 黑金世界的窄道上，让开。
lines.en: On the Black Gold's narrow path, move.
You can't move!

lines.zh: 我这一身鳞甲，撞上来很硬。
lines.en: My scaled body is hard to run into.
Move, or suffer!
You can't resist!
Avoid my attack, or else!
The ground in the black world is slick.
You can't avoid my attack!
Come, my love!
My mate, we mate!

lines.zh: 黑金之魂的气味，引来同类。
lines.en: The scent of Black Gold souls draws my kind.
With me!
You'll be with me!
Mate, my companion!
Mate with me!
We are one!
Mate with me together!

lines.zh: 两条尾巴缠在一起，就定了。
lines.en: Two tails twist together, and it is settled.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，你捡起了它的鳞片！
lines.en: Sssss... You picked up its scales!

lines.zh: 它的目光盯着你，你感到一阵寒意！
lines.en: Its gaze locks onto you, sending shivers down your spine!

lines.zh: 它的目光锐利，你只能小心应对。
lines.en: Its eyes are sharp; tread carefully.

lines.zh: 鳞片在黑暗中反射出冷光。
lines.en: Scales gleam coldly in the dark.

lines.zh: 你发现了一块它的鳞片碎片。
lines.en: You found a fragment of its scale.

lines.zh: 你感觉到它的存在，但看不见它。
lines.en: You sense its presence, but not its form.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在你手中散发寒意。
lines.en: Its scales chill your hand.

lines.zh: 你捡起了一块闪亮的鳞片。
lines.en: You picked up a shiny scale.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片冰凉，触感异常。
lines.en: Its scales are icy cold to the touch.

lines.zh: 鳞片边缘锋利，仿佛刚从刀锋上落下。
lines.en: The edges are razor-sharp, as if freshly sharpened.
My petrifying gaze has found you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进了我的沙里。
lines.en: Your boots stepped into my sand.
Its gaze pierces the darkness!

lines.zh: 锁定你的位置，黑金世界的岩缝记住了。
lines.en: Position locked; the black-metal crevices remember you.
Target in sight!
You feel its gaze!
It's tracking you!
Your position marked!
It has its eyes on you!
Your movements have been noticed!

lines.zh: 黑金世界，很久没来活物了。
lines.en: The black-gold world has had no living thing in ages.

lines.zh: 你的气味压过了矿石的腥。
lines.en: Your scent drowns out the ore's metallic tang.

lines.zh: 我的眼已经对准你的喉咙。
lines.en: My eye is already on your throat.
Do not move; my gaze will follow.

lines.zh: 你踩响的石头，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the stone you stepped on.
You are today's only prey.

lines.zh: 它的目光如冰雹般落下。
lines.en: Its gaze like hailstones.
It searches for prey in the darkness.
Its breath is close.

lines.zh: 黑金世界的石缝，就是我伏击的地方。
lines.en: These black-gold cracks are where I ambush.
Its eyes are full of malice.
Its scales reflect moonlight.
It waits for the perfect moment.
Its gaze is razor-sharp.
It's preparing to attack you.
Its breath is heavy.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，颈侧的鳞张开。
lines.en: I raise my head, and the scales on my neck flare.
My venom sacs swell under the jaw.
I circle slowly, in no hurry to bite.
When you look at me, your legs weaken first.

lines.zh: 矿石的味道盖不住你的血。
lines.en: The ore's smell cannot mask your blood.

lines.zh: 我的舌头先探路，牙齿随后。
lines.en: My tongue scouts ahead; my teeth follow.
Back to the wall, and you have no path.

lines.zh: 我把身体盘紧，像一根弹簧。
lines.en: I coil tight like a spring.
This strike will come from the side.
Do not look up into my eyes.

lines.zh: 黑金之土里的嘶声，就是我。
lines.en: That hiss in the blackened soil is me.
Your flesh shall nourish me!
One dose of venom will linger with you.
Death is your destiny!
You shall be dust!
My claws will tear you!
Your blood shall flow through me!
Your life will end here!
Your strength shall become mine!
You shall join my blood!
My fangs sink in: numb first, then pain!
My tail cracks across the back of your knee!
I pounce and pin you to the ground!
Venom climbs up from the wound!
My claws hold you down; do not struggle!
I hold my bite; the venom is not done!
I roll and coil, and your bones creak!
The black-gold stone strikes you for me!
Your throat tightens and no air comes!

lines.zh: 这一口，是黑金世界的规矩！
lines.en: This bite is the law of the black-gold world!
I wait in the darkness!

lines.zh: 黑金的土地，就是我的窝。
lines.en: This black-gold land is my den.
My venom is everywhere!
I move in the shadows!
Night is my feast!
I come from the depths!

lines.zh: 这里将是你最后的归宿！
lines.en: Here is your final resting place!
I wait in the darkness for prey!
I will guard this land!

lines.zh: 黑金世界的裂缝里，鳞光一闪。
lines.en: In a crack of the black-gold world, scales glint.

lines.zh: 我盘在矿脉上，慢慢抬头。
lines.en: Coiled on the ore vein, I slowly raise my head.

lines.zh: 黑金之魂在我体内发烫。
lines.en: A black-gold soul burns hot inside me.

lines.zh: 黑金世界没有水，只有火。
lines.en: The Augite world has no water, only fire.
The rocks hurt where they hit.
Water suffocates my breath.
The explosion tears my skin.
The arrow pierces my flesh.
Magic strikes my body.

lines.zh: 饥饿慢慢消耗我的力量。
lines.en: Starvation slowly drains my strength.
Lightning strikes me, intense pain.
Void rips my existence apart.
